phase: Phase 5: Embeddable Runtime, i18n, and Shared Package
summary: Phase 5 Green passes the security and data-handling review for the scoped embeddable-runtime work. The new GamesLocaleContext provides a host-injectable locale source without exposing raw HTML or executing user-controlled strings. The onNavigate callback contract is invoked only with literal 'back' | 'exit' | 'games' values, and representative games (haunted-library, dragon-rider) no longer perform hardcoded SPA navigation. The canonical games-runtime module consolidates VirtualDPad, withBasePath, and calculateClientXP without secrets or eval. gameCards.ts uses locale-agnostic /student/games/... hrefs. No secrets were found in locale files or the runtime module. Phase 3/4 server-side XP and fire-once contracts remain intact.
nonblocking_findings: NB-1: withBasePath concatenates NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_PATH and the supplied path without normalization or traversal checks. All current callers use static constants, so this is not an exploitable vulnerability, but a future caller passing user input could create unexpected URLs (e.g., basePath + '/../admin'). Consider adding a guard that rejects or normalizes '..' segments when the helper is later exposed to untrusted input.

NB-2: useScopedI18n/useI18n interpolate params via simple String(value) replacement. React text rendering escapes output, so XSS is not reachable in JSX, but any future consumer that passes the result to dangerouslySetInnerHTML or an href attribute would be responsible for its own sanitization. This is consistent with the current codebase and not a Phase 5 regression.

NB-3: Ten legacy games plus PotionRushGame still use window.location.href or router.push for navigation. plan.md correctly defers migrating those to the onNavigate contract as [b] deferred:infra in the successor track. They are outside Phase 5 scope and do not affect the representative-game proof.

NB-4: src/lib/games/babelArchitectCompliance.test.ts fails 8/10 assertions because the babel-architect game implementation files do not exist (only a gameCards entry is present). The test was updated for the locale-agnostic href change but the underlying game was not implemented. This is a pre-existing/product-scope issue, not a security or data-handling defect.
evidence: No dangerous rendering patterns (dangerouslySetInnerHTML, eval, new Function, document.write, raw innerHTML) were found in the changed source or test files.

Locale strings in apps/advantage-games/src/locales/en.ts contain only static translation text; a targeted secret-pattern scan across the runtime module and locale files found no API keys, tokens, or private credentials.
GamesLocaleContext.tsx exposes only a locale string via React context, defaults to 'en' when no provider is present, and does not execute or decode any host-provided code.
HauntedLibraryGame.tsx invokes onNavigate('exit') and dragon-rider/page.tsx invokes onNavigate('games') with literal values only; neither passes user data to the callback.
HauntedLibraryGame.tsx and dragon-rider/page.tsx no longer contain hardcoded /en/ routes or window.location/ router.push navigation.
gameCards.ts was rewritten to use locale-agnostic /student/games/... hrefs and imports withBasePath from the canonical @/lib/games-runtime module.
apps/advantage-games/src/lib/games-runtime/basePath.ts, xp.ts, VirtualDPad.tsx, and index.ts contain no environment secrets and no path-evaluation logic beyond string concatenation.
Anti-pattern A2 (consent-blind publish gate) is not triggered: Phase 5 introduces no draft-to-published status transition for named subjects.

Anti-pattern A6 (registry overstatement) is not triggered: measure/tracks.md does not claim D-07/D-09/D-11 / CA-013 / MR-H05 are resolved; the Phase 5 plan defers full production pilot import to the successor track.
